title: Harness inquiry envelope contract
description: Generic inquiry envelope shared by every harness function — the input counterpart of report.schema.json: every function is asked something about a session and answers with a report. Function inquiry contracts extend this envelope with function-specific properties. Session attribution is always observed or minted by the surrounding mechanism and never model-authored, so it is the one thing every inquiry carries — the session id exists before the session record does (function 0 registers a pre-minted id, it never creates one).

sessionId.description: The session this inquiry runs in.

parentSessionId.description: The parent session that opened this session, if any.
